title: COVID-19 susceptibility and severity effector gene predictions, COGS method (Thieke et al., 2021)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from:

Prioritisation of Candidate Genes Underpinning COVID-19 Host Genetic Traits Based on High-Resolution 3D Chromosomal Topology.
Thieke MJ, Yang EJ, et al.
Front Genet. 2021 Oct 25;12:745672. doi: 10.3389/fgene.2021.745672.
PMID: 34759959

In this study, the COGS (Capture Hi-C Omnibus Gene Score) pipeline (Javierre et al., 2016; Burren et al., 2017) was applied to promoter capture Hi-C data (PCHi-C) data from 17 primary blood cell types (Javierre et al., 2016) and from a SARS-CoV-2-infected lung carcinoma cell line (Ho et al., 2021) along with genetic associations from four different analyses performed by the COVID-19 Host Genetics Initiative.

The four GWAS analyses were:

  • A2: very severe respiratory confirmed COVID-19 vs. population
  • B1: hospitalized COVID-19 vs. not hospitalized COVID-19
  • B2: hospitalized COVID-19 vs. population
  • C2: COVID-19 vs. population

Click the "Research method" tab for more details.
